bio.text: Chris McCreight is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 46 in Brooklyn in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Alec Brook-Krasny; he won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
When he launched his 2024 campaign for the same seat, amNY described him as chief of staff to New York City Council Member Justin Brannan and a Democratic district leader for District 46.
He lost the 2024 general election for the seat to Brook-Krasny.

sources.title: Powerful Brooklyn pol's chief of staff launches bid to unseat Republican and take back Assembly seat Democrats lost in 2022
